title: UN Council's Surprising Shift on Ukraine-Russia Peace Resolution
description: On the third anniversary of Russia's invasion of Ukraine, the UN Security Council adopted a U.S.-drafted resolution seeking a neutral stance on the conflict. This marks a departure from previous U.S. policy under Biden. The resolution aims to foster peace between Russia, Ukraine, and the international community.

title: Global Shifts: Political Changes, Conflicts, and Migration Patterns
description: A summary of global developments: Germany's rightward political move concerns migrants; Israeli tactics in the West Bank cause upheaval; EU-Israel dialogue resumes; Venezuelan migrants return south; U.S.-Russia dialogues on Ukraine and Mexican drug lord 'El Mayo' seeks a plea deal. A retired French surgeon faces trial for child abuse.

title: US joins Russia to vote against UN resolution on Ukraine war; India and China abstain
description: The resolution was passed with the Europeans and the G7 (minus the Americans) voting in favour of the draft resolution.

title: US Sides With Russia Over UN Resolution on War
description: The UN General Assembly overwhelmingly condemned Russia for the war in Ukraine on Monday, though the US joined Moscow in voting against the measure, reports the Washington Post...

title: Macron Foresees Truce Between Ukraine and Russia
description: French President Emmanuel Macron indicated a potential truce between Ukraine and Russia might be reached soon. In a Fox News interview after talking with U.S. President Donald Trump, Macron stated that European leaders are prepared to offer security guarantees to facilitate the truce.
